reviews.text: Recent ban issues. I’ve had this app for 5 years and it’s been incredibly helpful, especially the community aspect. Including comments on other people’s posts, I’ve posted about 10 times total in 5 years. I’ve always been careful with my language and I’ve always followed the rules. Yesterday, after 5 years, my account was permanently banned from the community. There was no warning of any kind, no temporary ban before this, no posts of mine deleted, nothing. The last time I commented something was over a month ago. The reason listed was “inappropriate posts/comments” and I know that nothing I ever posted broke ToS. I’m not the only person this has happened to. I know of at least 3 other people who’ve been unfairly permanently banned in the last week. I’m hoping this just a mistake with whatever automated system is being used. This entire situation is extremely upsetting. I want to continue to enjoy using this app. I hardly have a reason to keep the app if this is how users are being treated. I hope something changes soon.
